name: Adaptive Density Control (Split & Clone)
definition: A mechanism to adjust the density of 3D Gaussians during optimization to match local scene complexity by duplicating or subdividing Gaussians based on their coverage relative to the target region.
summary: Adaptive Density Control (Split & Clone) is a 3D Gaussian Splatting densification strategy that uniquely combines cloning small Gaussians and splitting large ones to match scene complexity.
